posts.text:
Millions of Americans are affected by celiac disease or gluten intolerance. It’s a real and serious issue, and it’s time the food industry respected that. 

I actually have a gluten intolerance myself, and it’s terrifying when labels aren’t clear because that can have serious medical consequences. 

We need transparent labeling so Americans can make informed decisions and safeguard their health.
posts.summary: Advocates for food industry clarity on gluten labeling due to health risks
